name: TrueClash
source:
Welcome to Trueclash!

Step into Trueclash, a brutal martial arts tournament set in an alternate version of our world , slightly more advanced, slightly more dangerous. Here, in the heart of Vibrant City, MMA isn't just a sport... it's the king of all entertainment.

And you? You're the newcomer. A trainer trying to make a name for yourself. Whether you're chasing fame, love, or something else entirely,  that’s up to you.

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/c/trueclashgames/about]Patreon[/url]]
translation:
欢迎来到真实冲突！

走进《Trueclash》，这是一场残酷的武术锦标赛，背景设定在我们世界的另一个版本中，稍微更先进，也更危险。在这里，在充满活力的城市中心，MMA不仅仅是一项运动……它是所有娱乐之王。

你呢？你是新人。一名试图让自己出名的教练。无论你是在追求名誉、爱情还是其他完全不同的东西，这都取决于你。

[来自[url=https://www.patreon.com/c/trueclashgames/about]Patreon[/url]]
